description: This file defines the interface NoteShareItemAction, which declares methods for managing share actions such as permissions, email sharing, unsharing, and link management within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: NoteShareItemAction
classes.description: Interface for actions related to sharing notes, including managing permissions, sharing via email, unsharing, and link sharing.

methods.name: advancedPermissions
methods.description: Open advanced permission settings for the selected share.

methods.name: sendNewEmail
methods.description: Open the note screen to send a new email with the share.

methods.name: unShare
methods.description: Unshare or revoke the current share.

methods.name: sendLink
methods.description: Send the created share link, valid only for public links.

methods.name: addAnotherLink
methods.description: Create and share another link, valid only for public links.
